spells.name: Already Ducked
spells.description:
You watch the next second arrive a second early and lend it to whoever needs it. By the time the swing exists, its target already isn't there.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Amicus Brief
spells.description:
You file a friend-of-the-court brief on an ally's behalf: history itself weighs in, noting that people like them have prevailed before.

One ally within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Angle of Witness
spells.description:
Everything impossible is only impossible from most angles. You hold open the one angle from which the target can absolutely, definitely, be hit.

One creature you can see within range gains a −2 penalty to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

spells.name: Atlas Prism
spells.description:
A palm-sized prism that carries the weight of the world one refraction at a time — you aim it at someone and the incoming harm bends around their edges.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Bind Witness
spells.description:
You swear the target in. Whatever they do next is testimony, and the record does not permit evasive action.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spells.name: Borrowed Face
spells.description:
You reach into the crowd of selves you've dreamed being and put one on. It fits. It always fits. That's the unsettling part.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Breath Before the Cut
spells.description:
You put on the stillness like a coat. Your pulse does not rise. Your blade does not hurry. It doesn't have to.

spells.name: Hymn of the Open Vein

A dream-double peels off and keeps you company — scouting corners, standing in doorways, being the you that gets shot at first.

spells.name: Italic Emphasis

spells.name: Latchkey Lullaby
spells.description:
A small blue key that exists because you dreamed you owned it. It opens any lock that is, at that moment, asleep — and most locks are always asleep.

Bound tool: once per short rest, open one mundane lock, latch, or seal by singing it three descending notes. Wards, alarms, and anything actively watched are beyond it.

One of your spare selves learns an ally's part and shadows them through the scene, stepping into the worst moments in their place.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Unmasking Flash
spells.description:
One camera-flash of absolute accuracy. Disguises, glamours, and comfortable self-images all develop at once, in public.

Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Wall of My People
spells.description:
The names of everyone you're protecting settle over the ground like poured foundation. Allies inside stand behind all of them at once.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Bulwark.

spells.name: Warm Milk Ultimatum
spells.description:
The Quiet Sun leans on one furious person with the entire warm weight of every nap they ever refused. It is not a suggestion.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Wayhound Companion
spells.description:
A hound made of every shortcut you've ever taken. It knows the way, and it knows how to hold a stranger's ankle about it.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 force damage and is restrained for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Shadow Courier.

spells.name: We Signed For Each Other
spells.description:
You read out the mutual-defense compact this ground remembers: everyone here has been vouched for by someone. Violence becomes a breach of a promise with witnesses.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

spells.name: Wide Angle
spells.description:
You stop looking at the fight and start looking at the whole frame — every line of fire a thread of light you simply stand between.

You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.
